sentences.l1: Today I went to see the dentist.

sentences.l2: 牙医叔叔说我的牙齿需要清洁。
sentences.l1: The dentist said my teeth needed cleaning.

sentences.l2: 他用一个小镜子检查我的每一个牙齿。
sentences.l1: He used a small mirror to check every one of my teeth.

sentences.l2: 他还用一个小工具清洁了牙齿。
sentences.l1: He also used a small tool to clean my teeth.

sentences.l2: 我很高兴我的牙齿现在很干净。
sentences.l1: I am very happy that my teeth are very clean now.
